speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: An example of a minor non-compliance would be undertaking minor partition works that affect the fire safety design of a space without seeking approval from SCDF.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: An example of a serious breach is erection of illegal structures that would seriously compromise escape in the event of a fire.

speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
text: In view of the recent fire at the Kranji warehouse, does the Ministry feel that there is a need to adopt a tougher position against repeat offenders?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We are very serious and we will continue to ensure that fire safety is well adhered to by owners.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: Can I ask the Minister of State for serious cases of persistent reoffending, would the Ministry consider, if necessary, working with other agencies or Ministries to consider imposing a business suspension to deter reoffending?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: What is key, like what I said earlier, is an escalatory approach.
